workload.command: python -I -c "import os, time; import matplotlib; matplotlib.use('agg'); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; t = time.perf_counter(); [(lambda fig: (fig.savefig(os.devnull, format='png'), plt.close(fig)))(plt.subplots()[0]) for _ in range(50)]; print(time.perf_counter() - t)"
